# AI Efficiency Engineering
Use this skill for AI workflow configuration or developer-productivity optimization.

1. Inspect existing native instructions, agents, skills, workflows, and workspace configuration.
2. Use the project context and exact-symbol searches; do not re-scan the repository.
3. Route by task risk and model tier, not by a premium model default.
4. Avoid redundant agents, skills, plans, context, and verification.
5. Preserve all production, Test Mode, QR, and deployment safety rules.
6. Record only available metrics and do not claim savings without measurements.

Prefer one focused edit and one verification pass. Add longer plans only for medium/large work.
